answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own comet record, and its own share of the marble quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The horizon ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 511 identities would post 1742 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
